title.narrative: Trade promotion Open Trade Gate Sweden (OTGS)
Trade promotion Open Trade Gate Sweden (OTGS)

description.narrative: The overall goal of Open Trade Gate Sweden is to facilitate trade and increase exports from developing countries to Sweden. The scope of activities extends to all questions concerning the rules and requirements for exporting from a developing country to Sweden and the European Union as well as market information.
